name: Rayyan
msgs: I'm not asking to come back.
We were never strangers. That's what makes this hard.
I know. Can I just say sorry? No 'but'.
I'm sorry. I stopped choosing you before I stopped loving you.
That's the first honest thing you've said in a year.
closer: Some apologies arrive late. Late is still better than never.
follow: Part 2 of Sara & Rayyan next week
